title: Gitmap manifest (manifest.json)
description: Top-level manifest of a .gitmap package: exactly {"format":"gitmap","version":4}. A reader rejects any other version or any extra key. Units (map units, 0.01 mm) and precision (3 dp) are fixed by the spec; parts, georeferencing, extensions, notes and spot colours live in their own files.

version.description: Spec version. A reader accepts exactly this version; older packages are re-converted from source.
